title: NEX Directory Seed Listing
description: Public UK business listing imported from publicly-available business text per ADR-0023. Not a merchant account. No login, no verified status, no images.

id.description: UUID v4 generated at insert time. Preserved on claim.

primary_trade.description: Machine-readable trade slug (e.g. staircase_manufacturer · kitchen_manufacturer · kitchen_designer · kitchen_retailer · kitchen_supplier · kitchen_fitter). Enables filtering the directory by trade.

tags.description: Kebab-case tags for cross-cut queries (e.g. bespoke-kitchens · german-kitchens · shaker-kitchens). Never fabricated — set by the enrichment pipeline from published business text.

enrichment_status.description: Phase marker per Philip's phased-directory rule (2026-08-04). stub = seed name+city+category only · partial = some website fields extracted · verified = every field on record confirmed against the official source. Never skips ahead — enrichment moves forward one step at a time.

last_verified_at.description: ISO timestamp of the last enrichment pass that confirmed the record against the official website. Null until Phase 3.

email.description: ONLY if publicly listed by the business. Never inferred.

opening_hours.description: Structured object OR free-text string as supplied by source.

photos.description: MUST be empty at seed time (ADR-0022).

cover_image.description: MUST be null at seed time (ADR-0022).

source.description: Provenance of the initial record. `google_business_manual_paste` = imported from Google Business Profile text (staircase pipeline, ADR-0023). `philip_manual_seed` = Philip-authored trade-directory stub (kitchen pipeline · 2026-08-04). `refacing_discovery` = trade discovered via the UK Staircase Refacing discovery pipeline (2026-08-13) — an acquisition channel into the existing NEX Trade Center membership system.

capabilities.description: Per-capability answer for refacing trades. Absent keys default to "unknown". Never inferred.

refacing_evidence.description: Evidence records explaining why this trade qualifies as a refacing/refurbishment/covering/cladding company. At least one required for A+ and A qualifications.

refacing_qualification.description: A+ = explicit existing-staircase refacing/refurbishment/covering/cladding · A = strong existing-staircase renovation evidence · B = possible, needs verification · C = primarily new staircase work · excluded = does not qualify.

email_source.description: Where the public business email was found. Null when email is null.

email_verified.description: Human-verified as a working, publicly-published business address. Never true for an inferred email.

email_checked_at.description: ISO date the email was last checked.

lifecycle_status.description: Claim lifecycle inside the shared NEX Trade Center membership system. Refacing is an acquisition channel · once claimed the record follows the same paid-member funnel as every other trade. Never invented · flipped only by the shared claim/payment flow.

directory_state.description: Fundamental Refacing Trade Exchange progression (Philip 2026-08-13): listed = discovered/imported · verified = NEX independently verified the directory info (contact accuracy + evidence + operating) but still unclaimed · claimed = business owner claimed via shared claim flow · paid_member = active paying NEX Trade Center member eligible to receive routed homeowner opportunities. Distinct from the `verified` badge (earned via claim workflow) and from `lifecycle_status` (7-step claim funnel). Forward-only progression · never downgrade without an audit entry in refacing_evidence[].
